quarterly_data.signal: Rolls-Royce Power Systems and Saudi Engines Manufacturing Company (MAKEEN) signed an Individual License Agreement for local manufacturing and assembly of mtu Series 2000 marine engines in Saudi Arabia, building on a Framework License Agreement concluded in November 2023; Rolls-Royce says this makes it the first company to license local production of high-speed engines in Saudi Arabia, with marine targeted to be followed by rail.
